settings.distance_definition: Euclidean camera-to-declared-target slant distance in metres
settings.png: RGBA8 display sRGB, original unrescaled 1920x1080 evidence
settings.ground_for_metrics: Holdout ground at actual support plane clips hidden skirts; alpha is visible asset geometry only.
settings.ground_for_beauty: Matte procedural soil on the same plane; preview only, not exported.
settings.row_end_caps: Both ends; 20 caps plus 50 regular tiles.
settings.cache: Lossless compressed npz, never uncompressed persistent arrays.

limits: Offline source renders only; no Unreal import/HLOD/streaming/lighting validation.
Close views can crop; fitted hero views show whole assets.
4000m pixel coverage is resolution and FOV limited; magnified crops are labelled.
Geometry-only holdout-ground coverage excludes skirts and cast shadows. Soil-ground frames are appearance previews, not coverage masks.
